_comment: Personal pet room artwork, shared by the app (src/room/art.ts) and the backend photo export (backend/app/pet_room.py), so the room on screen and the saved photo are drawn from the same shapes. Canvas 400 x 440, the floor starts at floorY. Surfaces fill the wall or the floor. Items are drawn around their anchor (floor items: feet at 0,0; wall items and rugs: centre at 0,0); @tokens are filled from the chosen variant. `box` is the item's extent around the anchor (without glows), used to keep it inside its area. Ids of surfaces, items and variants are stored in saved rooms: only ever add.
